title: Project Portfolio Tracker
subtitle: Build a live-looking RAG portfolio dashboard that tells leadership exactly where to focus.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.role: Genpact APAC Client Delivery — 10 projects shown, RAG status (Green/Amber/Red), $8.2M revenue at risk, budget consumed %, milestone status, top risks and client satisfaction scores

learning_objectives: Attach a portfolio data file and let the AI read every RAG status, budget figure, and risk statement — your job is escalation judgment, not data lookup
Write the five things a tracker cannot tell an AI: who is running the review, what the management story is, which Red project is more urgent, and what specific action each escalation requires
Specify a RAG filter defaulting to Red view so leadership opens to escalations first — not buried in row 7 of a sorted table
Iterate with precision: name the single most important gap in your first output and fix only that in one follow-up
Deliver a portfolio dashboard that lets a VP run a 15-minute leadership review without PowerPoint — single HTML file, no server, no dependencies
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML project portfolio dashboard
